name: Swing the Censer

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Requirements You are holding your censer implement.

---
You swing your censer in a wide arc, causing the smoke it issues to thicken. Until the start of your next turn, creatures within the smoke are Concealed, and all creatures outside the smoke are concealed to those within it.
